producedBy: Pre-refactor implementations at commit 130912af: services/collector-r2-importer/src/central.ts centralDescriptorSha256 (client) and services/raw-evidence/src/store.ts parseArtifact + canonical.ts canonicalJson/sha256Hex (server).

vectors.name: canonical-storage-explicit
vectors.description: Every wire field present, optional scalars explicit, storage origin with explicit null optionals, empty arrays. Client and server digests agree.

vectors.name: canonical-storage-key-order-reversed
vectors.description: Same content as canonical-storage-explicit with every object key order reversed.

vectors.name: client-fills-null-and-empty-defaults
vectors.description: fetchUnitId, pageGroupId, pageIndex, origins, ranges, transformSteps, relations omitted; the v1 client normalizer fills null / [] for exactly these keys.

vectors.name: optional-scalar-null
vectors.description: dataset, formatId, formatVersion explicitly null.

vectors.name: optional-scalar-omitted
vectors.description: dataset, formatId, formatVersion omitted. The v1 client normalizer does not fill these keys, so its bytes differ from the explicit-null form; the server parser fills null and agrees with optional-scalar-null.

vectors.name: sequence-omitted
vectors.description: sequence omitted: client keeps the key absent; server stores null.

vectors.name: container-kind-omitted
vectors.description: containerKind omitted: the server defaults to single; the client does not.

vectors.name: media-type-uppercase
vectors.description: declaredMediaType with upper-case letters: the server lowercases; the client does not.

vectors.name: storage-optional-values-present
vectors.description: Storage origin with objectVersion, etag and the lastModified pair present.

vectors.name: storage-optional-values-omitted
vectors.description: Storage origin without its four optional keys: both sides fill null and agree with canonical-storage-explicit.

vectors.name: storage-time-pair-mismatch
vectors.description: lastModifiedAtMs without lastModifiedAtBasis: the server rejects; the client normalizer hashes without validating.

vectors.name: storage-unknown-key
vectors.description: Unknown key inside the storage origin: the client normalizer rebuilds the storage object from its ten known keys and silently drops it; the server rejects unknown_field.

vectors.name: unknown-top-level-field
vectors.description: Unknown top-level key: the client normalizer spreads it into the hashed value; the server rejects unknown_field. Run parseRequest first to reject on the client.

vectors.name: unicode-nfc
vectors.description: dataset with NFC e-acute, CJK and an astral emoji; bytes are raw UTF-8, never escaped.

vectors.name: unicode-nfd-not-normalized
vectors.description: Same text with NFD e + combining acute: must produce different bytes and digests (no Unicode normalization).

vectors.name: integer-max-safe
vectors.description: fetchedAtMs at Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is accepted by both sides.

vectors.name: integer-2-pow-53-rejected
vectors.description: fetchedAtMs = 2^53: the client encoder throws; the server rejects the field.

client.error: canonical numbers must be safe integers

vectors.name: float-rejected
vectors.description: Non-integer byteSize: the client encoder throws; the server rejects the field.

client.error: canonical numbers must be safe integers

vectors.name: negative-integer
vectors.description: Negative sequence: the client normalizer hashes it; the server rejects.

vectors.name: storage-origin-not-object
vectors.description: storage given as a string: both sides reject.

client.error: storage origin must be an object

vectors.name: http-origin-canonical
vectors.description: HTTP origin in server-canonical form (lower-case host, sorted unique queryNames, explicit null optionals).

vectors.name: http-origin-unsorted-query-names
vectors.description: HTTP origin with mixed-case host, duplicate unsorted queryNames and omitted optionals: server canonicalizes to http-origin-canonical; client bytes differ.

vectors.name: file-origin
vectors.description: File origin with every key present.

vectors.name: file-origin-source-modified-omitted
vectors.description: File origin without sourceModifiedAtMs: server stores null; client passes the object through unchanged.

vectors.name: email-origin-direct
vectors.description: Email origin (direct transport) with every key present.

vectors.name: email-origin-forwarded-minimal
vectors.description: Email origin with only transportShape and redactionVersion: server fills null for the other eleven keys.

vectors.name: ranges-canonical
vectors.description: Two ranges already sorted by rangeKey with integer inclusive flags.

vectors.name: ranges-reordered-boolean-inclusive
vectors.description: Same ranges in reverse order with boolean/omitted inclusive flags: server sorts and normalizes to ranges-canonical; client preserves array order and values.

vectors.name: transform-steps-canonical
vectors.description: Two transform steps in stepIndex order on a transformed payload.

vectors.name: transform-steps-reversed
vectors.description: Same steps in reverse order: server sorts by stepIndex; client preserves array order.

vectors.name: relations-explicit-parent-run
vectors.description: Relation with explicit parentRunId (equal to the run being written).

vectors.name: relations-parent-run-defaulted
vectors.description: Relation without parentRunId: the server defaults it to the current run; the client does not.

vectors.name: unit-and-page-references
vectors.description: fetchUnitId, pageGroupId and pageIndex present.

vectors.name: page-index-without-group
vectors.description: pageIndex without pageGroupId: the server rejects the pair; the client hashes.
